title: Department of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
content: The Department of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AI & ML) at SRM offers specialized B.Tech programs in Computer Science and Engineering with specialization in AI & ML. The department aims to produce engineers who can design and develop intelligent software agents, predictive models, and autonomous systems. The curriculum features deep modules on Probability and Statistics, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Natural Language Processing (NLP), Computer Vision, Reinforcement Learning, and AI Ethics. The department is equipped with modern GPU-enabled computing infrastructure for training large AI models. Students collaborate on research projects in healthcare analytics, smart city automation, financial forecasting, and speech recognition.
